title: News/lead-based Clanks: the QC vocabulary's fourth terminal action marks the item no longer distinct/novel
requirement: For a news/editorial or lead-based Clank, the QC decision vocabulary MUST support Useful, Not-useful, and False-positive, plus a fourth terminal decision named DUPLICATE, meaning 'this story/lead is not novel — it is already covered or is a restatement of something already known,' used in the vocabulary slot a SKU-based Clank fills with OUT_OF_STOCK. Additional Clank-specific decision values beyond these four MAY be added (e.g. a fifth value for editorial workflow state) without violating this standard.
rationale: This is the strongest-evidenced rule in this pass, because it is corroborated by two independently-originated lineages rather than one copied pattern. Chinese-tech-wire's LeadOutcome vocabulary and watch-clank's own separate SpecialistLeadReview vocabulary (distinct from its product-facing EventReview) both independently arrived at DUPLICATE for this slot — two different repos, two different authors' reasoning, the same conclusion, before any cross-copying occurred. korean-tech-wire (derived from CTW) and semiconductor-intelligence (which explicitly cites watch-clank's SpecialistLead as its precedent, not CTW/KTW) both propagate it, giving three separate lineages converging on the fleet's own gold-standard repo already containing this exact split internally.
forbidden: Using OUT_OF_STOCK as a literal decision value for a news/lead-based Clank (no e-commerce availability concept applies)
acceptance: USEFUL, NOT_USEFUL, FALSE_POSITIVE, and DUPLICATE are all distinct, queryable QC outcomes
No OUT_OF_STOCK value is present in a news/lead-based Clank's decision vocabulary

evidence.summary: The fleet's own gold-standard reference implements this exact split internally: OUT_OF_STOCK for product events, DUPLICATE for specialist leads — independent of any other Clank.
Independently-originated LeadOutcome vocabulary: USEFUL/NOT_USEFUL/WRITTEN/DUPLICATE/FALSE_POSITIVE, explicitly documenting 'Out of stock -> DUPLICATE' as the news-domain mapping.
QC_DECISIONS = (USEFUL, NOT_USEFUL, FALSE_POSITIVE, DUPLICATE), explicit rationale: 'there is no e-commerce out-of-stock concept for a news lead.'
Third, separately-cited lineage: explicitly references watch-clank's SpecialistLead using DUPLICATE in OUT_OF_STOCK's place as its own rationale, not CTW/KTW.

notes: RATIFIED 2026-08-30 by Operator Ratification Decision 001 (decisions/0003-operator-ratification-decision-001.md), unchanged from the Pass 1 proposal — the operator's assessment was that this was the best-evidenced rule in the pass. chinese-tech-wire's extra WRITTEN value is an allowed CTW-specific superset addition, not a violation — see acceptance criteria.
